nodes.name: CI workflow
nodes.summary: Main CI pipeline: formatting, linting (clippy on MSRV), tests on 6 platforms (Linux x86_64/ARM64, Windows x86_64/ARM64, macOS), dependency/license audit (cargo-deny), DCO sign-off check, and a ci-success aggregator job. Uses scripts/apt-install.sh for resilient package installation on slow mirrors.

nodes.name: Docs workflow
nodes.summary: Builds the mdBook manual on pushes to main and PRs touching docs/manual/. Installs a pinned mdBook binary, builds the manual, checks internal links for broken references, and deploys to GitHub Pages via actions/deploy-pages.

nodes.name: Publish workflow
nodes.summary: Triggers on release published events or manual dispatch. Delegates to oxiguitar-packages' reusable plugin-publish.yml workflow to notify package repositories (Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora, Flatpak, winget) when a new release is available.

nodes.name: Release workflow
nodes.summary: Runs oxiguitar-packages' reusable plugin-release.yml on PRs, pushes to develop/main, and v* tags. Builds plugin files for 6 targets (Linux x86_64/ARM64, Windows x86_64/ARM64, macOS universal) via build-oxp.sh, producing zips, .deb, .rpm, Windows installer, and macOS .pkg.
